metadata.title: pH 7.3 major-microspecies benchmark for ChEBI (Rhea mapping, open RDKit rules)
metadata.description:
A benchmark for predicting the major protonation state of ChEBI compounds at pH 7.3. It pairs 113,385 ChEBI entities with Rhea's chebi_pH7_3_mapping.tsv (8,402 of which map to a different protonation form) and adds predictions from open, RDKit-only rules (chemrof.converter.protonation), offered as an open alternative to the ChemAxon-computed mapping.

Files: benchmark.parquet (mapping rows with structures, train/dev/sealed split and predictions from two rule versions); disagreements.parquet (rows where the rules and Rhea pick different ChEBI IDs); chebi_structures.parquet (ChEBI SMILES used, with structures whose ChEBI SMILES fail to parse rebuilt from molfiles); chebi_unparseable_smiles.parquet (13,171 ChEBI SMILES that RDKit cannot parse, mostly a missing H on aromatic N-H); the exact Rhea file used; a data card and SHA256 checksums.

On rows where Rhea maps to a different form, the rules agree with Rhea's ChEBI ID 91.6% of the time. Against measured pKa values (IUPAC Digitized pKa Dataset, not redistributed here because it is CC BY-NC) the rules score 91.8% on a held-out set. See DATACARD.md and the method write-up in chemkg/chemrof.

Derived from ChEBI and Rhea (both CC BY 4.0); please cite them when using this dataset.
metadata.notes: Built with chemkg/chemrof commit 9c64166ce69c2b737aa892d6f12c86722b465edc (chebi-scratch/ph73/make_bundle.py). The sealed split has already been scored, so it is not a blind test set.
